godde goddiyan Ghuttan laadu baithki tu jatt bari ho lainde

oh ta dinde a supariyan koi farda hi nai 
lokan kole jaa jaa pittan koi kharda hi nai 
Sale gharo pair Puttan dekh din raashi 
Das kise sir utte kde hoyi badmashi  
asi shashtar vang kude peer rakhe ne nii

godde goddiyan Ghuttan laadu baithki tu jatt bari ho lainde 

Nale maara changa bolde te meria hi reesan 
meri dekh k charayi pen kaalje kayi cheesan
Das ghorea de vich ki a khachraan da kam nii 
Aa k hikk ch vajan kise ch aina dam niiii 
Hundi NIJJAR hi NIJJAR me sunnda rehna aaaa 
mera koi na muqabla me hun b kehna aaaa 
Hor emii taa ni naam har than bolda ni 
yaar Yaaran layi khare ne saada taan bolda 
jera rab ne lekhan ch hove likhea oh das kidaa kho lainge 

Vairi pabban bhaar krduga aitkiii tu jatt bari ho lainde 
godde goddiyan Ghuttan laadu baithki tu jatt bari ho lainde
